cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.def: used before an amount to show it is surprisingly large; up to.
senses: as much as = 'shuncha ham' – tenglikni bildiradi: I earn as much as you do.
cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.ex: It may be possible that the farm's produce will account for as much as 10% of the city's consumption overall.

mnem.story: Osh shuncha ko'p bo'ldiki, 'as much as' 10 kishiga yetdi – 'gacha, shuncha ham' degani.

cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.def: fresh fruit and vegetables that a farm grows and sells.
senses: verb /prəˈdjuːs/ = ishlab chiqarmoq
noun stress old on the FIRST syllable, verb on the SECOND
cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.ex: It may be possible that the farm's produce will account for as much as 10% of the city's consumption overall.
related: much of the produce is suited to the summer months

mnem.story: Professional dehqon dushanba kuni bog'idan yig'gan barcha 'produce' (meva-sabzavot)ni bozorga chiqardi.

cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.def: very noticeable or impressive because it is unusual or attractive.
senses: strike (v.) = urmoq; strike (v.) = xayolga kelmoq (it struck me that…)
cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.ex: On top of a striking new exhibition hall in southern Paris, the world's largest urban rooftop farm has started to bear fruit.

mnem.story: Messining 'striking' (hayratlanarli) zarbasi shu qadar ko'zga tashlanardiki, butun stadion o'rnidan turdi.

cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.def: the top outer surface of a building, used here as a place to farm.
cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.ex: On top of a striking new exhibition hall in southern Paris, the world's largest urban rooftop farm has started to bear fruit.

mnem.story: Bolalar 'rooftop' (tom usti)da to'p o'ynashdi va to'p pastga tushib ketdi.

cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.def: to produce fruit; (figurative) to give good results at last.
cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.uz: meva bermoq; (ko'chma) natija bermoq, samara bermoq
senses: bear (v.) = ko'tarmoq, chidamoq (bear the weight, bear the pain)
cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.ex: ...the world's largest urban rooftop farm has started to bear fruit.

mnem.story: Ayiq daraxtni silkitdi va daraxt nihoyat 'bear fruit' qildi – meva/samara berdi.

cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.formUz: meva bera boshladi; natija bera boshladi

cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.def: having a strong, particular taste.
cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.uz: ta'mli, kuchli mazali (intensely flavoured = juda mazali)
senses: intensely (adv.) = kuchli, jadal; flavour (n.) = ta'm, maza
cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.ex: Strawberries that are small, intensely flavoured and resplendently red sprout abundantly from large plastic tubes.

mnem.story: Lay's chipsining 'intensely flavoured' ta'mi shunchalik kuchliki, bir dona yegach og'zing achishadi.

cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.def: in a brilliant, richly colourful, dazzling way.
senses: resplendent (adj.) = yaltiroq, hashamatli, ko'zni qamashtiruvchi
cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.ex: Strawberries that are small, intensely flavoured and resplendently red sprout abundantly from large plastic tubes.

mnem.story: Qirol 'resplendently' (yaltirab) kiyingan – splendid, ya'ni ko'zni qamashtiradigan darajada hashamatli.

cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.def: to grow or appear, especially quickly and in large numbers.
cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.uz: unib chiqmoq, o'sib chiqmoq, kurtak yozmoq
senses: sprout (n.) = nihol, kurtak; Brussels sprouts = bir turdagi karam
cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.ex: Strawberries that are small, intensely flavoured and resplendently red sprout abundantly from large plastic tubes.

mnem.story: Sport bilan shug'ullansang, kuching 'sprout' qiladi – nihol kabi tez o'sib chiqadi.

cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.def: existing in very large amounts; plentiful.
senses: abundantly (adv.) = mo'l-ko'l; abundance (n.) = mo'l-ko'lchilik
cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.ex: Strawberries ... resplendently red sprout abundantly from large plastic tubes.

mnem.story: Bozorda bandalar (odamlar) 'abundant' – shunchalik ko'p va mo'l-ko'lki, yurishga joy yo'q.

cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.def: to look carefully or with difficulty, especially at something hard to see.
senses: peer (n.) = tengdosh, teng maqomdagi kishi (peer pressure)
cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.ex: Peer inside and you see the tubes are completely hollow, the roots of dozens of strawberry plants dangling down inside them.

mnem.story: Murid pir (peer)ning uyiga 'peer inside' qildi – sinchiklab ichkariga mo'raladi.

cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.def: having an empty space inside; not solid.
senses: hollow (adj., ko'chma) = quruq, ma'nosiz (a hollow promise = quruq va'da)
cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.ex: Peer inside and you see the tubes are completely hollow, the roots of dozens of strawberry plants dangling down inside them.

mnem.story: Halloween qovog'ini kovaklab, 'hollow' – ichi bo'sh qilib fonus yasashdi.

cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.def: a group of twelve; (plural) a large number.
cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.uz: o'n ikkita; (dozens of) o'nlab, juda ko'p
senses: a dozen eggs = 12 ta tuxum; dozens of = o'nlab
cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.ex: ...the roots of dozens of strawberry plants dangling down inside them.

mnem.story: Do'zaxda gunohlarni sanaganda 'dozen' – har safar o'n ikkitadan, o'nlab qilib sanashardi.

cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.def: to hang loosely and swing freely.
senses: dangle sth = biror narsani osiltirmoq (dangle a reward = mukofot ko'z-ko'z qilmoq)
cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.ex: ...the roots of dozens of strawberry plants dangling down inside them.

mnem.story: Gul poyasi shipdan 'dangle' bo'lib – osilib, dang qotib tebranib turardi.

cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.def: a green leafy vegetable eaten raw in salads.
cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.ex: From identical vertical tubes nearby burst row upon row of lettuces...

mnem.story: 'Let us' salat yeymiz! – deb do'stlar bir bosh 'lettuce'ni bo'lishib yeyishdi.

cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.def: having a pleasant, noticeable smell.
senses: aroma (n.) = xushbo'y hid, atir hid
cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.ex: ...near those are aromatic herbs, such as basil, sage and peppermint.

mnem.story: Choyxonadagi 'aromatic' o'tlarning aromasi shunchalik xushbo'yki, ko'chadan o'tganlar to'xtab qoladi.

cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.def: a sweet-smelling herb used in cooking.
cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.ex: ...aromatic herbs, such as basil, sage and peppermint.

mnem.story: Bazil ismli oshpaz har taomga bir barg 'basil' (rayhon) solib, xushbo'y qilardi.

cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.def: a grey-green herb with a strong smell, used in cooking.
senses: sage (adj./n.) = dono, oqil (a sage old man)
cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.ex: ...aromatic herbs, such as basil, sage and peppermint.

mnem.story: Dono chol (sage) sajdadan so'ng bir hovuch 'sage' o'tini choyga solib ichardi.

cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.def: a type of mint with a strong, fresh taste.
cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.ex: ...aromatic herbs, such as basil, sage and peppermint.

mnem.story: Qalampirdek achchiq va yalpizdek salqin 'peppermint' saqichi tilni muzlatib yubordi.

cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.def: small in width; not wide.
senses: narrow (v.) = toraymoq; a narrow escape = zo'rg'a qutulish
cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.ex: Opposite, in narrow, horizontal trays packed not with soil but with coconut fibre, grow cherry tomatoes, shiny aubergines and brightly coloured chards.

mnem.story: O'q (arrow) shunchalik 'narrow' – tor yo'lakdan o'tdiki, devorlarga tegmadi.

cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.def: a flat, shallow container for carrying or holding things.
cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.ex: ...in narrow, horizontal trays packed not with soil but with coconut fibre...

mnem.story: Ofitsiant uchta (three) choynakni bitta 'tray' – patnisga qo'yib olib keldi.

cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.def: a purple vegetable (US: eggplant).
senses: AmE'da eggplant deyiladi
cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.ex: ...grow cherry tomatoes, shiny aubergines and brightly coloured chards.

mnem.story: O'badagi jin qo'lida yaltiroq 'aubergine' – baqlajon ushlab olib qo'rqitib yurardi.

cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.def: a leafy vegetable with thick, often colourful stalks.
cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.ex: ...grow cherry tomatoes, shiny aubergines and brightly coloured chards.

mnem.story: Rangli poyali 'chard' sabzavoti chala pishgan yerdayam yorqin bo'lib o'saverardi.

cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.def: able to continue for a long time without harming the environment or running out.
cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.uz: barqaror, uzoq muddat davom eta oladigan (atrof-muhitga zararsiz)
senses: sustain (v.) = qo'llab-quvvatlamoq, saqlab turmoq; sustainability (n.) = barqarorlik
cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.ex: Pascal Hardy, an engineer and sustainable development consultant, began experimenting with vertical farming...

mnem.story: Sekin (sust) ishlagani uchun bu tizim 'sustainable' – uzoq, barqaror ishlab, hech tugamasdi.

cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.def: to some degree; a little; rather.
senses: Some- oilasi ↓ related'da: somehow, somewhere, sometime(s), someday, somebody/someone, something
cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.ex: The urban rooftop space above the exhibition hall is somewhat bigger: 14,000 square metres...

mnem.story: — Necha som? — 'Somewhat' qimmatroq, ya'ni biroz ko'proq, dedi sotuvchi noaniq.

cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.def: a small light basket or box for soft fruit like strawberries.
cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.ex: ...have picked, in one day, 3,000 lettuces and 150 punnets of strawberries.

mnem.story: Puxta yasalgan 'punnet' savatchaga aynan bir kilo qulupnay sig'ardi.

cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.def: a thing that limits or restricts what you can do.
senses: constrain (v.) = cheklamoq, majbur qilmoq
cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.ex: In the urban environment you're working with very significant practical constraints, clearly, on what you can do and where.

mnem.story: Qonun (kon) seni faqat 'straight' – to'g'ri yo'ldan yurishga majburlaydi: bu 'constraint', ya'ni cheklov.

cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.def: to grow or develop very well; to be very successful.
senses: flourish (n.) = dabdabali harakat/imo-ishora
cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.ex: ...this is a real-life showcase for the work of Hardy's flourishing urban agriculture consultancy, Agripolis...

mnem.story: Bu biznes xuddi 'flower' – gul kabi 'flourish' qildi, ya'ni gullab-yashnadi.

cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.def: to receive and deal with questions, calls or requests.
cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.uz: (savol/so'rovlarni) qabul qilib javob bermoq, uddalab bermoq
senses: field (n.) = dala, maydon, soha
cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.ex: ...which is currently fielding enquiries from around the world to design, build and equip a new breed of soil-free inner-city farm.

mnem.story: Dala (field)dagi dehqon telefon jiringlaganda barcha 'enquiries' – savollarni birma-bir qabul qilib, 'field' qildi.

cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.def: a request for information; a question.
senses: 'inquiry' (AmE) bilan bir xil; inquiry = rasmiy tekshiruv ma'nosida ham
cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.ex: ...which is currently fielding enquiries from around the world...

mnem.story: Kvartira (kvartira ≈ kwiry) haqida shuncha 'enquiry' – so'rov keldiki, telefon jim bo'lmadi.

cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.def: large in amount, size or importance.
senses: substantially (adv.) = ancha, sezilarli darajada; substance (n.) = modda; mohiyat
cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.ex: ...the varieties are selected for their capacity to withstand such substantial journeys...

mnem.story: Poyezd yer osti (sub) stantsiyasidan 'substantial' – juda uzoq va salmoqli yo'l bosib o'tdi.

cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.def: a company that buys goods in large amounts and sells them to shops, not to the public.
senses: wholesale (adj.) = ulgurji; retailer = chakana sotuvchi
cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.ex: ...80% of the price I pay goes to wholesalers and transport companies, not the producers.

mnem.story: Ulgurji 'wholesaler' butun (whole) omborni bir 'sale'da, ya'ni ulgurji sotib yubordi.

cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.def: only; not involving anyone or anything else.
senses: sole (adj.) = yagona, bittagina (the sole survivor)
cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.ex: Produce grown using this soil-free method ... relies solely on a small quantity of water, enriched with organic nutrients...

mnem.story: U 'solely' – faqat sof suvga tayanib, boshqa hech narsasiz o'simlikni o'stirdi.

cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.def: to use something up completely so nothing is left.
senses: exhausted (adj.) = charchagan, holdan toygan; exhaust (n.) = mashina tutuni/quvuri
cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.ex: No soil is exhausted, and the water that gently showers the plants' roots every 12 minutes is recycled...

mnem.story: Mashina 'exhaust' (eksguzi) benzinni to'liq yoqib 'exhaust' qildi – tugatib, zaxirani holdan toydirdi.

cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.def: the amount of a crop that is produced.
senses: yield (v.) = hosil bermoq; yon bermoq, taslim bo'lmoq (yield to pressure)
cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.ex: ...the method uses 90% less water than a classic intensive farm for the same yield.

mnem.story: Yer (yeld ≈ yield) dehqonga har yili katta 'yield' – mo'l hosil berardi.

cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.def: a fact or event that exists or happens, especially one that is noticed or studied.
senses: ko'pligi phenomena; ko'chma: g'ayrioddiy inson/narsa
cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.ex: Urban farming is not, of course, a new phenomenon.

mnem.story: Fen (soch quritgich) o'zi omon qolgani – kamdan-kam uchraydigan 'phenomenon' (hodisa) edi.

cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.def: morally good; (here) beneficial and creating a positive cycle.
cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.uz: fazilatli, ezgu, foydali (ijobiy aylanma hosil qiladigan)
senses: a virtuous circle = ijobiy zanjir (yaxshilik yana yaxshilik keltiradi) – vicious circle'ning teskarisi
cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.ex: Aeroponic farming, he says, is 'virtuous'.

mnem.story: Fazilatli (virtues egasi) odam har doim 'virtuous' – ezgu ishlar qilib, atrofga yaxshilik tarqatardi.

cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.def: cruel and violent; (a vicious circle) a bad situation that keeps making itself worse.
senses: Passажда yo'q – 'virtuous'ning aksi sifatida esda tuting: virtuous circle ↔ vicious circle
cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.ex: Cutting down forests causes floods, which destroy more land — a vicious circle.

mnem.story: Vahshiy (vicious) it 'vicious circle' – aylanib-aylanib egasini quvib, holdan toydirdi.

cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.formUz: yovuz doira; berk halqa (bir yomonlik ikkinchisini keltirib chiqaradi)

cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.def: a very small part or amount of something.
cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.uz: juda kichik qism, ozgina ulush; (matematikada) kasr
senses: a fraction of the cost = narxining ozgina qismi
cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.ex: It is cheap to run, too, consuming a tiny fraction of the electricity used by some techniques.
related: for a fraction of the price

mnem.story: Butun tortdan faqat bir 'fraction' – juda kichik parcha qoldi, qolganini yeb bo'lishgan.

cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.def: a person or company that grows crops to sell.
senses: grow (v.) = o'stirmoq, o'smoq
cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.ex: ...are lower than soil-based organic growers.

mnem.story: Eng mohir 'grower' – o'stiruvchi hatto toshdan ham gul undirardi.

cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.def: a vegetable that grows underground as a root, e.g. carrots or potatoes.
senses: root (n.) = ildiz
cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.ex: 'Root vegetables we cannot do, at least not yet,' he says.

mnem.story: Ruda kabi yer ostidan qazib olinadigan 'root vegetable' – sabzi va kartoshka.

cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.def: used to add that something is true up to now, even if it may change; not less than.
cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.uz: hech bo'lmaganda, kamida; (at least not yet) hozircha … emas
senses: at least = kamida, aqalli (at least 5 people)
cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.ex: 'Root vegetables we cannot do, at least not yet,' he says.

mnem.story: — Nechta? — 'At least' beshta, ya'ni kamida beshta et 'list' (ro'yxat)da bor, dedi qassob.

cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.def: a small, round, red-and-white root vegetable with a hot taste, eaten raw.
cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.ex: 'Radishes are OK, but carrots, potatoes, that kind of thing - the roots are simply too long.'

mnem.story: Radio (radish) tovushi ostida bog'bon bir tovoq (dish) 'radish' – turp tozalab o'tirardi.

cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.def: a seed or pod of certain plants, eaten as a vegetable.
senses: ko'chma: not worth a bean = arzimas; full of beans = g'ayratli
cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.ex: And beans tend to take up a lot of space for not much return.
related: beans take up a lot of space

mnem.story: Mister Bean butun bog'ini 'beans' – loviyaga to'ldirdi, lekin hosil ('return') juda oz chiqdi.

cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.def: a hole or hollow space inside something, here inside a tree trunk.
senses: tishdagi kovak (dental cavity) ma'nosida ham
cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.ex: In addition, trees with many cavities are extremely important habitats for insect predators like woodpeckers, bats and small mammals.

mnem.story: Daraxt tanasidagi 'cavity' – kovakka qushlar uya qurib, ichini to'ldirib olishdi.

cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.def: a small thorny tree or bush with white flowers and red berries.
cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.ex: For example, many species like hawthorn provide food for wildlife.

mnem.story: 'Ho, qara, tikan (thorn)!' – dedi bola 'hawthorn' do'lanasining shoxiga qo'li ilinib.

cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.def: wood prepared for building or making things; trees grown for their wood.
senses: AmE'da ko'pincha 'lumber'
cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.ex: A large, straight black cherry tree has high value as timber to be cut into logs or made into furniture...

mnem.story: Daraxtchi 'timber!' deb baqirdi – yog'och qulayapti, to'q rangli tanasi bor kuchi bilan yerga urildi.

cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.def: the main upright part of a tree or plant; the trunk or stalk.
senses: stem from (v.) = kelib chiqmoq (problems stem from…)
cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.ex: ...the real value of that stem (or trunk) may be the food it provides to animals.

mnem.story: Gul stakanga tik turishi uchun uning 'stem' – poyasi stakan tubiga tayaldi.

cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.def: the thick main woody stem of a tree.
senses: fil xartumi; mashina bagajniki; katta sandiq ma'nolari ham bor
cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.ex: ...the real value of that stem (or trunk) may be the food it provides to animals.

mnem.story: Traktor yo'g'on daraxt 'trunk' – tanasini arqon bilan bog'lab sudrab ketdi.

cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.def: the usual or standard way of doing something; what is typical.
senses: norms (pl.) = ijtimoiy qoidalar; the norm = odatdagi holat
cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.ex: The norm was to remove the stems of highest quality and leave behind poorly formed trees...

mnem.story: Zavodda kunlik 'norm' – normani bajarish odatiy qoidaga aylangan edi.

cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.def: to block sunlight from smaller plants so they cannot grow.
cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.uz: soya solib (yorug'likni to'sib) o'stirmaslik, bo'g'ib qo'ymoq
senses: shade (n.) = soya; shade (v.) = soyalatmoq
cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.ex: These trees ... compete for growth with higher-value trees, shade out desirable regeneration and decrease the health of a stand...

mnem.story: Katta daraxt soya (shade) solib, kichkina nihollarni 'shade out' qildi – yorug'liksiz bo'g'ib tashladi.

cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.formUz: soya solib, kerakli qayta o'sishni bo'g'ib qo'yish

cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.def: wanted or worth having because it is useful or good.
senses: desire (v./n.) = xohlamoq, orzu
cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.ex: ...shade out desirable regeneration and decrease the health of a stand...

mnem.story: Har bir bog'bon orzu (desire) qiladigan 'desirable' – maqbul nihollar shu yerda o'sardi.

cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.def: the natural growth of new young trees/plants to replace old ones.
senses: 'desirable regeneration' = o'rmonda ko'paytirilishi ISTALGAN yangi, foydali nihollar
cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.ex: ...shade out desirable regeneration and decrease the health of a stand...

mnem.story: O'rmonning yangi avlodi (generation) – 'regeneration' qaytadan unib, bo'sh joyni to'ldirdi.

cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.def: (of plants) spreading aggressively and harming the plants that belong there.
senses: invasive surgery = organizmga aralashuvchi jarrohlik ma'nosida ham
cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.ex: Removing invasive plants might be another primary goal of a TSI Cut.

mnem.story: Begona o't bog'ga xuddi 'invasive' – bosqinchi (invaziya) kabi bostirib kirib, hamma yerni egalladi.

cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.def: the leaves of a tree or plant, considered together.
cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.ex: The stems that are left behind might then grow in size and develop more foliage and larger crowns or tops...

mnem.story: Kuzda daraxtning 'foliage' – barglari folga (foliy) kabi oltinrang tovlanib turardi.

cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.def: the top part of a tree, made of its branches and leaves.
senses: crown = toj (podshoh toji) ma'nosida ham
cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.ex: ...develop more foliage and larger crowns or tops that produce more coverage for wildlife...

mnem.story: Daraxtning eng tepasidagi 'crown' – shox-shabbasi xuddi yashil toj (crown) kabi boshida turardi.

cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.def: to change or adapt something to fit a particular need or purpose.
senses: tailor (n.) = tikuvchi, darzi
cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.ex: TSI Cuts can be tailored to one farmer's specific management goals for his or her land.

mnem.story: Darzi (tailor) kostyumni o'lchab tikkanidek, reja ham har fermerga 'tailored' – moslab bichildi.

cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.def: to save something usable from damage or loss; (adj.) a cut that removes damaged trees.
cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.uz: qutqarib olmoq, yaroqli qismini saqlab qolmoq
senses: salvage (n.) = halokatdan qutqarilgan narsa/mol
cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.ex: Another approach that might yield a high amount of low-use wood is a Salvage Cut.

mnem.story: Yong'indan keyin dehqon sal bo'lsayam yaroqli yog'ochni 'salvage' qildi – qutqarib oldi.

cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.formUz: qutqaruv kesimi (zararlangan daraxtlarni yaroqli ekan kesish)

cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.def: an insect or animal that harms plants, crops or trees.
senses: ko'chma: bezovta qiluvchi odam ('what a pest!')
cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.ex: With the many pests and pathogens visiting forests ... those working in the forests can help ease these issues...

mnem.story: Zararkunanda 'pest' hosilni past darajaga tushirib, hammasini yeb bitirdi.

cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.def: a tiny organism such as a bacterium or virus that causes disease.
cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.ex: With the many pests and pathogens visiting forests including hemlock wooly adelgid...

mnem.story: Kasallik yo'li (path) orqali kelgan 'pathogen' butun o'rmonni og'ir xastalikka soldi.

cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.def: a tiny sap-sucking insect that attacks and kills hemlock trees.
cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.uz: hemlok (archasimon) daraxtiga tushadigan mayda so'ruvchi hasharot
senses: 'hemlock' = archasimon ignabargli daraxt turi
cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.ex: With the many pests and pathogens visiting forests including hemlock wooly adelgid, Asian longhorned beetle, emerald ash borer, and gypsy moth...

mnem.story: Mayda hasharot hemlok daraxtini hammasini oq 'lok' (yung) bilan qoplab, so'rib quritdi.

cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.def: a beetle with very long antennae whose larvae bore into and kill trees.
senses: 'long-horned' = uzun shoxli/mo'ylovli
cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.ex: ...including hemlock wooly adelgid, Asian longhorned beetle, emerald ash borer, and gypsy moth...

mnem.story: Uzun shoxli (long horn) qo'ng'iz daraxt tanasini burg'udek teshib, ichini kemirib yubordi.

cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.def: a bright green beetle whose larvae bore under the bark of ash trees and kill them.
senses: emerald = zumrad (yorqin yashil); ash = shumtol daraxti; bore = teshmoq
cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.ex: ...including hemlock wooly adelgid, Asian longhorned beetle, emerald ash borer, and gypsy moth...

mnem.story: Zumraddek (emerald) yashil qo'ng'iz shumtol po'stlog'ini teshib (bore), daraxtni ichdan yeb qo'ydi.

cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.def: a moth whose caterpillars eat huge numbers of tree leaves, damaging forests.
cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.uz: kapalak turi (qurtlari barglarni yeb daraxtga zarar beradi)
senses: moth = kuya/tungi kapalak
cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.ex: ...emerald ash borer, and gypsy moth, to name just a few...

mnem.story: 'Gypsy moth' kuyasi bir kechada butun daraxtning barglarini yeb, uni yalang'och qoldirdi.

cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.def: an established or official way of doing something, step by step.
senses: medical procedure = tibbiy muolaja
cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.ex: ...those working in the forests can help ease these issues through cutting procedures.

mnem.story: Shifokor har bir 'procedure' – protsedurani aniq tartibda, bosqichma-bosqich bajardi.

cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.def: strong, healthy and full of energy.
senses: vigorously (adv.) = qattiq, jon-jahdi bilan
cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.ex: They leave vigorous trees that have stayed healthy enough to survive the outbreak.

mnem.story: Kasallikdan omon qolgan 'vigorous' – baquvvat daraxt yana kuch (vigor) bilan o'sib ketdi.

cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.def: the sudden start of something bad, especially a disease or pest spreading.
senses: outbreak of war/fire = urush/yong'in boshlanishi
cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.ex: They leave vigorous trees that have stayed healthy enough to survive the outbreak.

mnem.story: Kasallik to'satdan yorib (break) tashqariga (out) chiqdi – haqiqiy 'outbreak', ya'ni avj olish boshlandi.

cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.def: to make trees/plants less crowded by removing some of them.
senses: thin (adj.) = ingichka, oriq; thinnings (n.) = siyraklashtirishda kesilgan yog'och
cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.ex: A Shelterwood Cut, which only takes place in a mature forest that has already been thinned several times...

mnem.story: O'rmonchi qalin o'rmonni 'thin' qildi – ba'zi daraxtlarni olib, siyraklashtirib tinchitdi.

senses: seed (n.) = urug'
cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.ex: ...involves removing all the mature trees when other seedlings have become established.

mnem.story: Bir donagina urug' (seed) unib, kichkina 'seedling' – nihol bo'lib bosh ko'tardi.

cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.def: having two levels or layers (here, trees of two different ages/heights).

cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.ex: It can also be used to develop a two-tier forest so that there are two harvests...

senses: retain (v.) = saqlamoq, ushlab qolmoq; water retention = suv ushlanishi

cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.def: to put something into a group according to its type or quality.
senses: classification (n.) = tasnif; classified = maxfiy (hujjat)
cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.ex: ...some retention of what many would classify as low-use wood is very important.

cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.ex: ...trees with many cavities are extremely important habitats for insect predators like woodpeckers, bats and small mammals.

mnem.story: Qizilishton yog'ochni (wood) cho'qib-cho'qib (peck) 'woodpecker' nomini oldi – ichidagi hasharotni terib yedi.

cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.ex: They help control problem insects and increase the health and resilience of the forest.

mnem.story: O'rmon zarbadan keyin qaytadan silliqlanib, o'ziga keldi – bu uning 'resilience' – chidamliligi edi.

cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.def: the variety of different shapes, sizes, ages and species within a forest's structure.
cambridge-18-test-1-reading-1.uz: tuzilmaviy xilma-xillik (turli yosh, bo'y va turdagi daraxtlar rang-barangligi)
senses: diversity (n.) = xilma-xillik; structural (adj.) = tuzilmaga oid

C20-r1.def: large or important enough to have an effect or to matter.

C20-r1.def: an organism like mould or a mushroom, some of which cause disease.

mnem.story: Vazadagi (vaza) suv poyaning naysimon tomir (vascular) tizimi orqali yuqoriga ko'tarildi.

C20-r1.def: a region or administrative area of a country, like a province.

C20-r1.ex: it became a key component of birch, ash and hazel woodlands.

C20-r1.ex: to see if they can withstand the fungus by cutting a small slit on the bark and injecting a tiny amount of the pathogen.

C20-r1.def: judging only by how it first appears (though the truth may differ).

C20-r1.def: to notice, see or understand something in a particular way.

mnem.story: Klinikada (clinic) unga jiddiy klinik depressiya (clinical depression) tashxisi qo'yildi.

C20-r1.def: a feeling of strong worry or nervousness.
C20-r1.ex: people with clinical depression and anxiety seem unable to switch away from a state in which they absorb all the negative messages.

mnem.story: Uzundan-uzoq anketa (anketa) to'ldirish undagi xavotirni (anxiety) yanada oshirdi.

C20-r1.def: to become stiff and unable to relax, usually from stress or fear.
C20-r1.ex: If a co-worker is stressed, we are more likely to tense up and feel stressed ourselves.

mnem.story: Tennis (tennis) finalida u shu qadar tarang tortdiki (tense up), raketkani qattiq siqib oldi.

C20-r1.forms: in some ways · in many ways
C20-r1.def: to a certain extent; in some respects but not all.
C20-r1.ex: In some ways, many of us now live as if we are in danger.

mnem.story: Ba'zi jihatdan (in some ways), tanlagan yo'lim (way) biroz (some) xavfli edi.

C20-r1.def: set in advance to behave in a fixed, automatic way; built-in.
C20-r1.ex: a pre-programmed physiological reaction, which evolution has equipped us with to help us avoid famished predators, is now being triggered by an online post.

mnem.story: Miyamizga oldindan dastur (programma) yozilgandek, bu tug'ma (pre-programmed) reaksiya o'z-o'zidan ishga tushdi.

C20-r1.def: extremely hungry; starving.
C20-r1.ex: evolution has equipped us with to help us avoid famished predators.

mnem.story: Ovqatsiz qolgan fermer (farmer) kechga borib juda och (famished) bo'lib qoldi.

C20-r1.def: to make something seem larger, worse or more important than it really is.
C20-r1.ex: But that has the effect of exaggerating existing danger.

mnem.story: U kichkina mushukni jirafadek (giraffe) ulkan qilib bo'rttirib (exaggerate) gapirdi.

C20-r1.forms: hold on · held on · holding on
C20-r1.def: to keep something and not sell or give it up; to wait.
C20-r1.uz: ushlab turmoq; sotmay saqlamoq; kutib turmoq
C20-r1.ex: stocks are sold, even when holding on is the best thing to do.

mnem.story: Narx tushsa ham, aksiyalarni sotmay ushlab turish (holding on) eng to'g'ri qaror edi.

C20-r1.def: careful, responsible and taking your duties seriously.
C20-r1.ex: help us frame our messages more effectively and become conscientious agents of change.

mnem.story: Vijdonli (conscientious) konchi (miner) har bir vazifasini halol va mas'uliyat bilan bajardi.

C20-r1.def: a person or thing that actively causes or drives change.
C20-r1.ex: help us ... become conscientious agents of change.

mnem.story: Maxfiy agent (agent) kabi, u jamiyatda o'zgarish tashabbuskori (agent of change) bo'ldi.
